summary: Define governed agent Skill DSL standard

delivery.outcome: A portable governed Skill DSL that deterministically routes stable diagnostics to bounded agent operations while keeping LLM decisions advisory and protected changes fail-closed.
nonGoals: Redefine agent role or repair lifecycle authority
Generate shell, argv, URI, transport or merge commands
Automatically resolve stash, license, secret, ambiguous or destructive findings

architecture.decision: Own only skill definitions, catalogs and propose-only selection contracts; compose external agent, priority, policy, POA and repair lifecycle packs; enforce protected safety classes in dependency-free conformance.
interfaceChanges: Introduce the experimental wellmanifest.skills/v1 document family
dataChanges: Add closed skill definition, catalog, selection request and recommendation documents
architecture.rollback: Remove the five ticket-owned standard files while preserving the governed baseline and ticket evidence.
